[[Andhra Pradesh]] has the 2nd longest coastline of 974 km in the eastern peninsular [[India]], which accounts for 12% of the country's total coastline with one major (Operational) and 14 non–major (5 Operational) ports, with six ports under development in the [[Public–private partnership|PPP]] mode.<ref name="ports list">{{cite web|title=Ports in AP|url=http://www.andhraports.com/apports.htm|publisher=Department of Ports (Government of Andhra Pradesh)|access-date=29 May 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140929021059/http://www.andhraports.com/apports.htm|archive-date=29 September 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Cargo handling ==
[[File:Far view of Kakinada port from Beach.jpg|thumb|View of Kakinada port from Beach]]
The state's ports handled 73 million tons of cargo in financial year 2015–16.<ref name="IBTimes">{{cite news|author1=Rama Mohan|title=AP to Set up Maritime Board to Develop Ports|url=http://www.ibtimes.co.in/ap-set-maritime-board-develop-ports-604320|access-date=26 July 2014|work=ibtimes.co.in|publisher=International Business Times, India|date=13 July 2014}}</ref> The state of Andhra Pradesh is the second maritime state (after [[Gujarat]]) in terms of cargo handled by Non-Major Ports and the third maritime state (after Gujarat and Maharashtra) in terms of overall cargo handled including Visakhapatnam port trust .<ref>{{cite news|author1=P.Manoj|title=Dugarajapatnam in Andhra Pradesh to have new major port|url=http://www.livemint.com/Politics/bOhk7gMjTCGnUqamWzNYAM/Dugarajapatnam-in-Andhra-Pradesh-to-have-new-major-port.html|access-date=26 July 2014|work=Live Mint and The Wall Street Journal|date=10 May 2013}}</ref>

=== Exports and imports ===

Exported products are [[Rice]], [[Wheat]], [[Maize]], [[Soya bean]] meal and retraction, [[Rice bran]] extraction, [[Bentonite]], [[Fibre]], [[Fish Meal]], [[Tobacco]], [[Sand]], [[Cement]] [[Iron ore]], [[Cement clinker]], [[Minerals]]  etc. Some of the imports include [[Potassium chloride|Murate of Potash]], [[Rock phosphate]], [[Urea]], [[Palm oil|Crude Palm Oil]], [[Edible oils]], [[Chemicals]], [[Gases]], [[Wood pulp]], [[Machineries]] etc. [[Lightering]] of [[Crude oil]] also takes place.<ref>{{cite web|title=Cargo Spectrum|url=http://www.andhraports.com/ch.htm|website=Andhra Ports|publisher=Department of Ports (Government of Andhra Pradesh)|access-date=26 July 2014}}</ref>

==List==
The state has one major port at Visakhapatnam under the administrative control of Central government and 15 notified ports inclusive of 3 captive ports under the control of state government.<ref name="soc-eco-sur-2022-23">{{Cite book |title=Socio Economic Survey 2022-23 |last=DOP |publisher=Government of AP |year=2023 |url=https://apfinance.gov.in/downloads/FINALBOOKSES-2023FINAL.pdf|page=183}}</ref>
